description: This file defines the SharedFDSet class, a wrapper around std::set<SharedFD> for managing file descriptor sets in a select-like operation, and declares the SharedFD version of select function, used for multiplexing I/O on shared file descriptors.

classes.name: SharedFDSet
classes.description: A class that manages a set of SharedFD objects, providing methods similar to STL containers and POSIX fd_set operations.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the set.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the set.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of this set with another SharedFDSet.

methods.name: Clr
methods.description: Removes a SharedFD from the set.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if a SharedFD is in the set.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Adds a SharedFD to the set.

methods.name: Zero
methods.description: Clears all SharedFDs from the set.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Performs a multiplexed I/O operation on the provided sets with a timeout.
